item.stem:
Adil looks at the diagram of parallelogram $ABCD$. Base $AB=8\,\mathrm{cm}$. The perpendicular height from $D$ to line $AB$ is $5\,\mathrm{cm}$. Side $AD=6\,\mathrm{cm}$.

Which claim correctly finds the area?

options.A: Area $= 8 \times 5 = 40\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$, using base $AB$ and its corresponding perpendicular height.
options.B: Call the full answer the label base, and stop there.
options.C: Area $= 8 \times 6$, using side $AD$ as the height for base $AB$.
options.D: Finding the area is what creates the perpendicular height from $D$ to $AB$.
